info.title: CloudWatch Logs Fetcher
info.description: Lists an EC2 instance's log groups, or searches one around an incident time

get.summary: Discover an instance's log groups, or search one for log lines and activity gaps
get.description: Two modes. DISCOVERY: pass only instance_id (no log_group_name) to list every log group that instance has, e.g. its Nginx access/error logs and each application container. Never guess a log group name; discover it first. SEARCH: pass log_group_name (from discovery) plus instance_id. With time_string, returns lines_before and lines_after that exact moment; without it, the most recent lines. Every search also returns activity_all_lines: how many lines were logged per time bin across the whole window, ignoring filter_text, with silent_gaps listing periods where nothing at all was logged. A silent gap at the incident time with a normal line just before it is strong evidence of a hang, even when no error line exists.

parameters.name: instance_id
parameters.description: EC2 instance ID, e.g. i-0123456789abcdef0. Alone, it lists that instance's log groups.

parameters.name: log_group_name
parameters.description: Exact log group name returned by discovery. Omit it to run discovery instead.

parameters.name: filter_text
parameters.description: Case-insensitive text the returned lines must contain. Separate alternatives with |, e.g. error|timeout|exception. Leave empty to see every line — do that when investigating a hang, since a frozen process often logs no error at all.

parameters.name: time_string
parameters.description: Exact UTC incident time, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. Whenever an incident time is known (from an alarm or the user), pass it: the search centres on that moment instead of the current time.

parameters.name: window_minutes
parameters.description: With time_string: minutes before and after the incident to cover (1-180).

parameters.name: hours_back
parameters.description: Without time_string: hours back from now to search (1-24).

parameters.name: lines
parameters.description: Maximum lines to return on each side of the incident (1-50).

200.description: Discovery result, or log lines plus an activity summary
